targets.title: Feeling the future: Experimental evidence for anomalous retroactive influences on cognition and affect
targets.evidence_quote: The purpose of this experiment was to seek to replicate Bem=s Experiment 9 with the addition of a personality test.
targets.outcome_quote: In this experiment we failed to replicate Bem=s findings and found no support for retrocausal recall.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict in the conclusion governs; agreement on an ancillary null personality correlation does not override the overall judgment.

reasoning: New 102-participant sample re-tests Bem Experiment 9 with an added personality questionnaire. Other replication attempts and meta-analyses are background rather than targets. Original DOI is not printed in this source.
